_help: Test cases. tests.js turns them into report tables for content.js (the helper tests), and uat.js turns them into the UAT pack. Replace the example cases. Write only real results: keep actual, status, tester and date empty until a real test run fills them in. status is Pass, Fail or Blocked.
_uat: true: the test pipeline builds the UAT pack as Outputs/<output>.docx and .pdf.
_reports: Reports of the project's own automated tests (JUnit XML or Jest JSON), relative to Source/, for example "../Inputs/report.xml". The test pipeline turns them into tests-auto.json.

cases.title: Log in with a valid account
steps: Enter the email and the password of the account.
cases.data: The email and password of the test account

cases.title: Log in with a wrong password
steps: Enter the email of the account and a wrong password.
cases.expected: The page shows "Wrong email or password" and the dashboard does not open.

cases.title: Add a record
steps: Fill in the form and select Save.
cases.expected: The new record shows in the table.
